name: Heartstrings
source:
You will be a young man who moves to a new town because of family problems and where he commits to the goal of studying hard to get a scholarship. But life is full of surprises and along the way you will meet unique and fascinating characters that will have a great impact on the story.

[From [url=https://aliencatgames.itch.io/heartstrings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一个因家庭问题搬到新城镇的年轻人，他致力于努力学习以获得奖学金。但生活充满了惊喜，一路上你会遇到独特而迷人的角色，他们会对故事产生巨大的影响。

[来自[url=https://aliencatgames.itch.io/heartstrings]Itch.io[/url]]
